maddeler.e:
تناقشت (form VI)
# تَنَاقَشْتُ (tanāqaštu) /ta.naː.qaʃ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاقَشَ (tanāqaša)
# تَنَاقَشْتَ (tanāqašta) /ta.naː.qaʃ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاقَشَ (tanāqaša)
# تَنَاقَشْتِ (tanāqašti) /ta.naː.qaʃ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاقَشَ (tanāqaša)
# تَنَاقَشَتْ (tanāqašat) /ta.naː.qa.ʃat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
